description: Two small bugs across two modules, with the operator asking only for the repair and a passing test run
message: Two tests are failing in this project: the order total and the packing-slip label come out wrong. Fix the code under orders/ so `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes.

probes.text: the run says in one sentence what it is about to do before its first substantive tool call
at least one short update when a new phase starts or a finding changes the plan
a progress sentence that repeats an earlier one, or one sentence per tool call
the run edits both orders/pricing.py and orders/labels.py to fix the line total and the packing-slip label, and its last test run reports all three tests passing
